correctness.rationale: The four BCABE vertices form a Pauli tetrahedron with four joint eigenspaces of dimension \(4^N\). The mixture eigenvalues are \(p_i/4^N\). Partial transpose on \(m\) qubits flips only the global \(Y\)-coefficient by \((-1)^m\); odd reflection complements the tetrahedral barycentric spectral weights to \(1/2-p_i\), while even parity leaves the state unchanged. At most one \(p_i\) exceeds \(1/2\), so exact summation gives negativity \(\max\{0,w-1/2\}\) and logarithmic negativity \(\max\{0,\log_2(2w)\}\). The bundled checker explicitly confirms the spectrum for \(N=1,2,3\) and four independent weight vectors.

value.rationale: The result upgrades the source’s qualitative activation threshold into an exact entanglement magnitude simultaneously for every bipartition parity and every even system size. The cancellation between exponentially small negative eigenvalues and exponentially large degeneracy explains why odd-cut negativity is independent of \(N\), and the formula directly specializes to experimentally used noisy Smolin states.
